mail/imap_exchange#

The command channel of an IMAP connection: tags, literals, responses in order.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The command channel of an IMAP connection: tags, literals, responses in order. ImapSession uses it.

One command runs at a time; its tag is chosen when it starts. A tagged NO or BAD comes back for the caller to handle; a transport or protocol failure closes the connection.
